name: ceilord
description: Ceilord public site and private-access signup infrastructure.

scripts.cf:deploy:bootstrap: npm run site:vendor && node scripts/cloudflare-deploy-ready.mjs production && node scripts/cloudflare-bootstrap.mjs
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run site:vendor && node scripts/cloudflare-deploy-ready.mjs production && wrangler deploy --env=
scripts.cf:deploy:dev: npm run site:vendor && node scripts/cloudflare-deploy-ready.mjs dev && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.cf:deploy:staging: npm run site:vendor && node scripts/cloudflare-deploy-ready.mjs staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
